# Repository Planning Standards

Use these standards for all planning artifacts in `docs/planning`.

## Requirements Standards
- Use strict noun shall verb format with a measurable condition in every requirement.
- Each requirement must have a unique ID, rationale, owner, and verification method.

## Capability Mapping
- Every capability must map to at least one requirement.
- Capabilities must include a success metric and minimum threshold.

## Path Research
- Each capability must have at least two researched implementation paths.
- Each path must include evidence, risks, and tradeoffs.

## Agent/Skill Recommendations
- Each agent or skill must specify role, scope, triggers, and expected outputs.

## Roadmap Structure
- Roadmap must include milestones, owners, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.

## Quality Bar
- All planning artifacts must be auditable, traceable, and actionable.
- Gaps and open risks must include owner and target closure date.
